section: MHDSR: Methods in Health Data Science with R
text:
MHDSR: Methods in Health Data Science with R
Outside working hours I organize MHDSR, an independent training pathway covering applied biostatistics, survival analysis, and machine learning with R, delivered live to research teams and open cohorts:

BIOSTATR: Applied Biostatistics with R (foundations)
ML4HOR: Machine Learning for Health Outcomes with R (prediction)

title: Imad El Badisy, PhD
text:
Hi, I’m Imad

I am a research engineer in health data science and computational methodologist building open-source tools and methodology for reproducible health research.
My focus is making advanced statistical methods accessible to health researchers. Learn more from the software packages I build.
Get in touch at elbadisyimad@gmail.com or ielbadisy@cm6.ma.

title: Imad El Badisy, PhD
text:
About me
I hold a PhD in Biomedical Sciences from Aix-Marseille University (SESSTIM laboratory) on missing data and machine learning methods for survival analysis. I develop software, including survalis for interpretable survival machine learning, survdnn for deep survival models, and funcml for functional machine learning, and design agentic workflows that bridge statistical rigor with modern computation. See my full list on the software page.
Moroccan and French national, husband and father.
See my education and experience or download my CV (PDF).

title: Imad El Badisy, PhD
text:
Research
My research develops computational methods for health data: survival machine learning (individualized prediction, neural survival models, RMST summaries, trajectory phenotyping), missing-data imputation, interpretable ML for clinical reasoning, and agentic data science for analytical workflows.

title: Imad El Badisy, PhD
text:
Consulting
I provide independent methodological and statistical consulting for health research teams, from study design through publication.

Study design and analysis plan review
Statistical methodology (survival analysis, functional data, predictive modeling)
Evidence synthesis
Machine learning prediction for health outcomes
Custom R package and tool development

Engagements are scoped individually: short advisory sessions, analysis support on a specific study, or longer-term collaboration. Get in touch →

title: Accessibility commitment
text:
Feedback
I welcome feedback on the accessibility of this site and the educational materials I create. Please let me know if you encounter any accessibility barriers by using the contact page and I’ll do my best to respond promptly.

title: Accessibility commitment
text:
Accessibility practices
This site has been designed with the following features in mind:

A color palette that meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards for contrast
Alternative text for all informative images
Readable font faces, chosen to avoid impostor letter shapes and mirroring
A light and dark theme, with a toggle in the navigation bar

I’m not a web developer, but I try to regularly audit the site for accessibility failures and fix what I can, using tools such as the WAVE Web Accessibility Evaluation Tool.
